item.title: Fixed vs Variable Utility Rates: Which One Saves You More Money?
item.description:
If you live in a state with energy choice (deregulated market), you’ve probably seen offers to “lock in” your electricity or gas rate for 12–36 months. Is that a good deal? Should you float with the market instead? Or is there a third option? Learn more in How Do Smart Meters Work?.

This guide breaks down fixed vs variable utility rates, explains when each makes sense, and gives you a decision framework. Learn more in Electric Bill Breakdown.
